title: Cookie Policy
description: Vublox Limited (“Vublox,” “we,” “our,” or “us”) utilizes cookies and similar technologies on our website, mobile applications, and other services (collectively referred to as the “Platform”) to enhance your experience. This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, your options regarding cookies, and additional details about the technologies we employ.

sections.title: What Are Cookies?
sections.description: Cookies are small data files stored on your device (such as a computer, smartphone, or tablet) when you visit a website. They are commonly used to make websites function more efficiently and to provide information to website owners. Cookies enable a website to recognize your device and remember your preferences over time.

sections.title: Types of Cookies We Use
sections.description: Vublox uses several categories of cookies on the Platform.

items.title: Essential Cookies:
items.description: These cookies are necessary for the basic operation of the Platform. They enable core functions like user login, security, and accessibility. Without these cookies, certain features of the Platform may not be available.

items.title: Performance and Analytics Cookies:
items.description: These cookies collect data on how users interact with the Platform, such as which pages are visited frequently and if any errors occur. The information is aggregated and anonymized, helping us improve the Platform’s performance.

items.title: Functional Cookies:
items.description: These cookies remember your preferences and settings, such as your username, language, or region, to provide a more personalized experience. They can also recall changes you’ve made to elements like text size and other customizable features.

items.title: Advertising and Targeting Cookies:
items.description: These cookies are used to deliver ads relevant to you and your interests. They also limit the number of times you see an advertisement and help measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns. These cookies may track your browsing habits to build a profile of your interests.

sections.title: How We Use Cookies
sections.description: Vublox uses cookies for various purposes, including:

items.title: To Ensure the Platform Functions Correctly:
items.description: Essential cookies help us provide you with the services you request, such as accessing secure areas of the Platform.

items.title: To Improve User Experience:
items.description: Functional cookies allow us to remember your settings and preferences, making your experience on the Platform smoother and more personalized.

items.title: To Analyze and Improve Performance:
items.description: Performance and analytics cookies help us understand how users interact with the Platform, so we can enhance its functionality and user experience.

items.title: To Deliver Relevant Advertisements:
items.description: Advertising cookies enable us and our advertising partners, like Google AdMob, to display ads that are more relevant to you based on your interests and browsing behavior.

sections.title: Third-Party Cookies
sections.description: In addition to our own cookies, we may also use various third-party cookies to report usage statistics of the Platform, deliver advertisements, and improve marketing efforts. For example, Google AdMob may place cookies on your device to serve ads that are more relevant to your interests.

sections.title: Your Choices Regarding Cookies
sections.description: You have the right to accept or decline cookies. Most web browsers automatically accept cookies, but you can usually modify your browser settings to decline cookies if you prefer. However, please note that disabling cookies may impact your experience on the Platform, and some features may not function as intended.

items.title: Managing Cookies:
items.description: You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings. This includes blocking or deleting cookies that have already been set.

items.title: Opting Out of Targeted Advertising:
items.description: If you do not want to receive personalized ads, you can opt out through your browser settings or by using opt-out tools provided by advertising networks.

sections.title: More Information on Cookies
sections.description: To learn more about cookies and how to manage or delete them, you can visit the help section of your browser or refer to resources such as {link1} or {link2}

sections.title: Changes to This Cookie Policy
sections.description: Vublox may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. Any updates will be posted on this page, and we encourage you to review this policy regularly to stay informed about our use of cookies.
